tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Terminal background. prwale never paints it; listed so previews match a typical dark terminal.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Background of the selected queue row (both lines), full pane width.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of inline code and fenced code blocks in rendered markdown.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Rules, pane divider, ┬/┴ junctions, inactive tab underline.

tokens.name: bright
tokens.usage: PR title in the detail pane, selected row title, active tab label.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text: row titles, descriptions, Jira summaries.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: repo, inactive tabs, non-urgent reasons (awaiting review, draft).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Hints, labels, timestamps, conventional-commit prefixes. 3.4:1 on surface: below 4.5:1, kept on purpose for de-emphasis; never use for anything the user must read to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus and navigation only: brand word, selection bar ▍, active tab underline ━, search prompt.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Blocked on you: failing checks ✗, conflict ⊘, changes requested ↺, NEEDS ATTENTION.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Waiting on others: running checks ◐, review required ○, WAITING group, Jira In Progress.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Clear: passing/approved ✓, synced dot, QUIET group, Jira Done.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Changed since last sync: ● dot before age, CHANGED group and tab count.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Jira identity: issue keys and the No Jira count. Never used for state.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on filled state badges (NEEDS ATTENTION / WAITING / CLEAR).

tokens.name: cell-1
tokens.usage: One terminal cell: gap between glyph and text.

tokens.name: cell-2
tokens.usage: Detail pane side margin; gap between row fields.

tokens.name: cell-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs and between footer key hints.

tokens.name: cell-5
tokens.usage: Second-line indent of a queue row, aligning #number under the title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: a terminal has no corners.

tokens.name: radius-preview
tokens.usage: Only the outer frame of HTML previews.

tokens.name: wide-breakpoint
tokens.usage: Columns at which the list and detail sit side by side; below it they stack.

tokens.name: list-share
tokens.usage: List pane width in wide mode, clamped to 44–84 columns.

tokens.name: chrome-rows
tokens.usage: Header, rule, rule, footer. Everything else is content.
